newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA says unaffected by union action.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA says unaffected by union action.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said that all its branches would open for business as normal on Wednesday, despite stop-work meetings called by the Finance Sector Union.

"The stop work meetings called for by the Finance Sector Union will only involve a small number of colleagues employed in a few operations centres in Sydney and surrounds," CBA Corporate Relations Head Lyndell Fraser said in a statement.

"The stop work meetings scheduled for mid-afternoon do not affect our front line staff nor the ongoing provision of branch services to our customers, all of our branches will remain open and provide full banking services," Fraser said.
CBA's shares closed up 16 cents at A$11.22 on Tuesday.
